annotations.title: Site profile: page metadata + security headers + robots/llms.txt + DNS, mail auth and domain age in one call

description: Use when an agent must vet or research a website in one call (lead research, security or SEO check, is this site legit). Input: url or bare domain. Output: JSON page metadata, HTTP status, HTTPS and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, server and hosting hints, 7 security headers, robots.txt (sitemaps, AI-crawler rules), llms.txt presence, plus domain DNS, mail provider, SPF/DMARC and RDAP registrar, age and expiry. Use instead: web_audit for a graded score with fixes; web_check for only up/down and latency; domain_lookup for DNS, mail auth and registration only (no page fetch). Example: ?url=stripe.com Price: $0.009 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

url.description: Site URL or bare domain (https:// assumed); private/internal targets → 400 (not charged)
